description: Runtime configuration for the google-slides-agent-catalog Skill Tool. Paths are resolved relative to the directory that contains this file unless they are absolute. No secrets are stored here; credentials are read from environment variables at run time.

phases.label: Prepare files and canvas
phases.purpose: Establish the file, page setup, workspace and editing foundation before content work.
phases.checkpoint: Create a named version checkpoint before the first structural edit.

phases.label: Build theme and layouts
phases.purpose: Define masters, layout families, placeholders, fonts and color roles once, centrally.
phases.checkpoint: Capture the theme build in its own named version before applying it to content slides.

phases.label: Structure slides and linked objects
phases.purpose: Set slide order, layouts, backgrounds, skip state and cross-file relationships.
phases.checkpoint: Record slide order and skip state so reordering can be reverted.

phases.label: Create content objects
phases.purpose: Create editable text, images, shapes, lines, tables, charts, diagrams and language quality.
phases.checkpoint: Insert content as native editable objects; snapshot before bulk replacements.

phases.label: Arrange, align and format
phases.purpose: Control stacking, alignment, distribution, guides, precision and object effects.
phases.checkpoint: Verify geometry against guides before effects are applied.

phases.label: Add media and motion
phases.purpose: Add audio, video, transitions and animations that survive real delivery.
phases.checkpoint: Confirm media access permissions and fetch playback success before recording.

phases.label: Handle imports and conversions
phases.purpose: Exchange files with PowerPoint and other formats without hidden damage.
phases.checkpoint: Keep the original imported file untouched; repair only a copy.

phases.label: Localize content
phases.purpose: Adapt text, terminology, locale formats and bidirectional layout.
phases.checkpoint: Freeze the source-language version before creating language variants.

phases.label: Apply privacy and governance gates
phases.purpose: Scan, minimize and gate content before any audience can reach it.
phases.checkpoint: Never publish or share until this phase reports a pass.

phases.label: Assure accessibility
phases.purpose: Verify alt text, reading order, contrast, captions, keyboard operation and language.
phases.checkpoint: Re-run accessibility checks after every layout change.

phases.label: Verify quality and fidelity
phases.purpose: Run regression, playback, export and accessibility tests before release.
phases.checkpoint: Record the tested version before fixes are applied.

phases.label: Repair and recover
phases.purpose: Apply the smallest responsible repair and re-run dependent checks.
phases.checkpoint: Preserve the failed state for diagnosis before rolling back.

phases.label: Automate and extend
phases.purpose: Automate repeatable work with Apps Script and vetted add-ons under least privilege.
phases.checkpoint: Require script scope review and a dry run before unattended execution.

phases.label: Deliver and export
phases.purpose: Operate presenter delivery and produce static outputs that match the deck.
phases.checkpoint: Test the delivery route as an audience member before the live session.

phases.label: Configure access
phases.purpose: Assign least-privilege roles and confirm collaborator access paths.
phases.checkpoint: Record the approved permission matrix and the approver before changes.

phases.label: Publish and distribute
phases.purpose: Publish, embed, email or link the deck through approved channels only.
phases.checkpoint: Require explicit approval and a post-send route verification.

phases.label: Document and support
phases.purpose: Record help, training and feature-discovery pointers for the delivered system.
phases.checkpoint: Attach the capability record to the delivered deck version.

phases.label: Evaluate and maintain
phases.purpose: Score coverage, benchmark reliability and maintain skills as Slides changes.
phases.checkpoint: Store benchmark results with the skill version they describe.

gates.requirement: A Google Workspace or consumer Google account with Slides enabled is required; detect edition and admin policy before acting.
Publishing, external sharing, add-ons and Apps Script may be disabled by administrator policy; confirm availability before planning dependent steps.
Embedded audio, video and linked files must be readable by the intended audience or playback fails for them.
Fonts, captions and language features vary by account, locale and device; verify rendering before delivery.
Clipboard, voice typing, full-screen and presenter features depend on browser and OS support; verify in a clean supported browser.
Recent Slides features roll out gradually by account, region and browser; detect availability rather than assuming it.

approval.note: Approval tokens are supplied by the operator at run time; no token is stored in this package.

spec_defaults.deprecation_policy: Review at every Google Slides feature rollout; retire when an equivalent native capability supersedes this skill.
spec_defaults.success_condition_template: The requested Slides outcome is produced as native editable objects, verified with recipient-equivalent access, and no unintended object, permission or export change remains.
